main_body: Large leaf canopy blob with a short dark-brown trunk and root flare at the bottom (rows ~60-78)
top_band: Canopy top: light and mid greens clumped at rows ~2-20 reading as the top of a rounded volume, with a lighter upper canopy shading down to darker green. There is no flat horizontal band, as this is organic foliage.
evidence: The organic tree is a rounded canopy with lit light-green clumps on the upper part and darker green with shadow gaps on the lower part, over a visible trunk and root flare. It reads as a volume seen from slightly above, not a flat elevation and not an isometric side. The canopy is lighter at the top and darker toward the underside, and the trunk sits beneath it. This is the normal 3/4 treatment for a tree.

style.evidence: The candidate has about 4 green steps (dark, mid, light, lighter) plus a dark brown trunk, against about 6 in the references. The outer outline is a near-black, almost neutral line around the silhouette, which gives a sticker look, whereas Beodeul uses dark green next to leaves. The canopy has pixel-clump texture with some variation but the clumps are blocky and large, and it lacks the per-leaf highlights and fine rim light of the references. The trunk is a mostly flat dark brown with few highlights. Overall it is somewhat thinner and flatter than the references, with a muddy mid-tone and weak contrast between the clumps.
